decisions.reason: As the publicly announced flagship of the enterprise messaging direction, with heavy investment and home-page visibility, management will keep it and treat any weak results as temporary ramp-up.
Its dedicated page and fit with the electronic document workflow strategy create visible commitment, and digitalization demand since 2020 lets management attribute any shortfalls to temporary causes.
The conversion service extends the core multichannel messaging offer at low marginal cost, and regulated customers still rely on fax, so persistence is justified.
The feature is cheap to maintain and close to the fax core, though its low visibility and declining fax volumes make quietly folding it into the base offer somewhat more likely.
Sandbox protection supports the security positioning the firm names as a key competitive argument, and the rising threat landscape reinforces commitment to it.
